title: [3.2] po file parser throws fatal when dealing with translation comments

milestone.description: Bugfixes and minor features for the 3.2 line.

body:
This is a (multiple allowed):
- [x] bug
- [ ] enhancement
- [ ] feature-discussion (RFC)
- CakePHP Version: 3.2.3
- Platform and Target: php7 nginx.
### What you did

got translation from .po file with this content:

```
#: firstfile:39
msgid "Pending"
msgstr "En cours"

#: secondfile:12
msgctxt "Pay status"
msgid "Pending"
msgstr "En cours"
```
### Expected Behavior

while the example isnt best case, po file parser should handle it like firstfile having msgctxt - note if i add it to firstfile or remove from secondfile it works 
### Actual Behavior
